title: PolicyGuard: Prompt-Configurable Semantic DLP for LLM Coding Agents
title_zh: PolicyGuard：面向 LLM 编码代理的可提示配置语义 DLP
abstract_en: AI coding agents accept free-form natural language prompts that may inadvertently contain credentials, personally identifiable information (PII), or proprietary business data. Existing data loss prevention (DLP) solutions rely on rigid regex patterns, model fine-tuning, or vendor-managed classifiers with limited customizability. We present PolicyGuard, a pre-model interception framework that classifies user prompts using an LLM guided by a natural language policy file. Our key contributions are: (1) the policy-as-prompt paradigm, where DLP classification criteria are defined entirely in a plaintext policy document editable by non-engineers without code changes or model retraining; (2) a sealed evaluation protocol with template-family-level data splits, hidden holdouts, and frozen test sets to rigorously assess generalization; and (3) a comprehensive empirical evaluation across 2,000 multilingual prompts demonstrating 96.5% effective block rate (EBR) with only 3.0% false positive rate (FPR) on a frozen test set of 927 prompts, and perfect 100% accuracy on a 217-prompt hidden holdout. Information-matched baseline experiments show that PolicyGuard's natural language format significantly outperforms equivalent content in JSON format (McNemar chi-squared = 31.58, p < 0.001) and dramatically outperforms zero-shot classification (Cohen's h = 0.915). Cross-model portability experiments demonstrate that the same policy achieves 86.4-96.5% EBR across four different LLMs without modification.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 PolicyGuard，一个部署在模型调用前的拦截框架，用于检测 AI coding agents 用户提示词中可能泄露的凭证、PII 或企业敏感数据。不同于依赖正则表达式、微调模型或厂商托管分类器的传统 DLP 方案，PolicyGuard 使用自然语言 policy 文件指导 LLM 完成语义级分类，使非工程人员无需改代码或重新训练即可调整规则。论文还提出 sealed evaluation protocol，通过模板族级数据划分、隐藏 holdout 和冻结测试集评估泛化能力。在 2,000 条多语言提示词实验中，PolicyGuard 在 927 条冻结测试集上达到 96.5% effective block rate 和 3.0% false positive rate，并在 217 条隐藏 holdout 上报告 100% accuracy。对照实验显示，自然语言 policy 显著优于等价 JSON 格式，也明显优于 zero-shot classification；跨模型实验表明同一 policy 可在四种 LLM 上实现 86.4%–96.5% EBR。需要注意的是，论文已被作者撤回，原因是仍需补充实验验证以支撑结果的严谨性。
key_points_zh: 核心方法是 policy-as-prompt：将 DLP 判定规则写成可编辑的自然语言 policy 文件，由 LLM 在模型调用前对用户 prompt 进行分类。
目标场景是 LLM coding agents，重点防止 prompt 中泄露 credentials、PII、proprietary business data 等敏感信息。
论文设计 sealed evaluation protocol，包括 template-family-level splits、hidden holdouts 和 frozen test sets，以降低数据泄漏并测试泛化。
实验报告显示，PolicyGuard 在多语言 prompt 上实现高 EBR、低 FPR，且同一 policy 可迁移到多个 LLM；自然语言 policy 优于等价 JSON 表达和 zero-shot baseline。
重要限制：该论文已被撤回，作者表示需要更多实验验证，因此当前结果应视为初步且未充分确认。

llm_assessment.comment: PolicyGuard targets a concrete production risk for coding agents with configurable pre-model DLP, though it is narrower than a full agent governance framework.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: PolicyGuard 针对编码智能体的生产级数据泄露风险提出可配置的模型前置防护，但范围窄于完整的智能体治理框架。
